title: Lockheed Martin VP tried to bring the craft out into the open

tellings.quote: That's why you had the vice president of Lockheed Martin trying to get the craft and hardware that they have obtained a long time ago out the back door

plain: A vice president of Lockheed Martin, the defense contractor, is said to have tried around 2008 to 2010 to get a recovered craft and its hardware, obtained long before, "out the back door" so it would no longer be kept secret inside the company. The guest Jeremy Corbell tells Michels this, repeating what he credits to three people he names as his sources, Jim Ryder, Colm Kelleher and James Lacatski. If true, it would mean a major contractor holds hardware from a craft not made by humans.
